WITH ss AS ( SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_color IN ('light', 'midnight') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND ss_list_price BETWEEN 286 AND 300 AND ca_state IN ('NM', 'TN') AND d_year = 2000 AND d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year ), ws AS ( SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_color IN ('light', 'midnight') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND ws_list_price BETWEEN 286 AND 300 AND ca_state IN ('NM', 'TN') AND d_year = 2000 AND d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year ) SELECT ss1.ca_county, ss1.d_year, ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales AS web_q1_q2_increase, ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales AS store_q1_q2_increase, ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales AS web_q2_q3_increase, ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales AS store_q2_q3_increase FROM ss ss1 INNER JOIN ss ss2 ON ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county AND ss2.d_qoy = 2 INNER JOIN ss ss3 ON ss1.ca_county = ss3.ca_county AND ss2.ca_county = ss3.ca_county AND ss3.d_qoy = 3 INNER JOIN ws ws1 ON ss1.ca_county = ws1.ca_county AND ws1.d_qoy = 1 INNER JOIN ws ws2 ON ss1.ca_county = ws2.ca_county AND ws1.ca_county = ws2.ca_county AND ws2.d_qoy = 2 INNER JOIN ws ws3 ON ss1.ca_county = ws3.ca_county AND ws1.ca_county = ws3.ca_county AND ws3.d_qoy = 3 WHERE ss1.d_qoy = 1 AND CASE WHEN ws1.web_sales > 0 THEN ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss1.store_sales > 0 THEN ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales ELSE NULL END AND CASE WHEN ws2.web_sales > 0 THEN ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss2.store_sales > 0 THEN ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales ELSE NULL END ORDER BY ss1.ca_county;

SELECT SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount" FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE (i_manufact_id IN (117, 306, 658, 849, 891) OR i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57)) AS filtered_item ON filtered_item.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-01-14' AND CAST('1999-01-14' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY) AS filtered_date ON filtered_date.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cs_item_sk, AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_disc FROM catalog_sales cs_sub JOIN date_dim d_sub ON d_sub.d_date_sk = cs_sub.cs_sold_date_sk WHERE d_sub.d_date BETWEEN '1999-01-14' AND CAST('1999-01-14' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND cs_sub.cs_list_price BETWEEN 236 AND 265 AND cs_sub.cs_sales_price / cs_sub.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.45 AND 0.65 GROUP BY cs_item_sk ) AS subq ON cs.cs_item_sk = subq.cs_item_sk WHERE cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > 1.3 * subq.avg_disc AND filtered_item.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND cs.cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND filtered_date.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

WITH item_avg_discount AS ( SELECT cs_item_sk AS i_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS threshold_amt FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN '1998-03-22' AND CAST('1998-03-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 119 AND 148 AND cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.58 AND 0.78 GROUP BY cs_item_sk ) SELECT SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount" FROM (SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_ext_discount_amt FROM catalog_sales) cs JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE (i_manufact_id IN (291, 335, 604, 696, 887) OR i_manager_id BETWEEN 35 AND 64)) i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1998-03-22' AND CAST('1998-03-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY) d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item_avg_discount ia ON cs.cs_item_sk = ia.i_item_sk WHERE cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > ia.threshold_amt AND cs.cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND i.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND d.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND ia.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL GROUP BY () ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

WITH subquery_avg AS ( SELECT cs_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_disc FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2000-02-27' AND CAST('2000-02-27' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND cs_list_price BETWEEN 260 AND 289 AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.75 AND 0.95 AND cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cs_item_sk ) SELECT SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount" FROM (SELECT * FROM item WHERE (i_manufact_id IN (295, 363, 372, 688, 719) OR i_manager_id BETWEEN 11 AND 40) AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL) AS i JOIN (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL) AS cs ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2000-02-27' AND CAST('2000-02-27' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL) AS d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk JOIN subquery_avg ON cs.cs_item_sk = subquery_avg.cs_item_sk AND cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > subquery_avg.avg_disc ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_sales INNER JOIN ( SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1215 AND 1215 + 11 ) filtered_date ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk INNER JOIN ( SELECT c_customer_sk, c_last_name, c_first_name FROM customer WHERE c_birth_month IN (3, 6, 7, 8) ) filtered_cust ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = filtered_cust.c_customer_sk WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 241 AND 300 AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 65 INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_sales INNER JOIN ( SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1215 AND 1215 + 11 ) filtered_date ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk INNER JOIN ( SELECT c_customer_sk, c_last_name, c_first_name FROM customer WHERE c_birth_month IN (3, 6, 7, 8) ) filtered_cust ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = filtered_cust.c_customer_sk WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 241 AND 300 AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 65 INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_sales INNER JOIN ( SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1215 AND 1215 + 11 ) filtered_date ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk INNER JOIN ( SELECT c_customer_sk, c_last_name, c_first_name FROM customer WHERE c_birth_month IN (3, 6, 7, 8) ) filtered_cust ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = filtered_cust.c_customer_sk WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 241 AND 300 AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 65 ) hot_cust LIMIT 100;

WITH inv AS ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean, CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev/mean END AS cov FROM ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean FROM inventory, item, warehouse, date_dim WHERE inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND d_moy IN (2, 3) AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 47 AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 225 AND 425 GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy ) AS foo WHERE CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev/mean END > 1 ) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM inv AS inv1, inv AS inv2 WHERE inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.d_moy = 2 AND inv2.d_moy = 3 AND inv1.cov > 1.5 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov ;

WITH inv AS ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean, CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev / mean END AS cov FROM ( SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean FROM inventory, item, warehouse, date_dim WHERE inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001 AND d_moy IN (1, 2) AND i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Sports') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 30 AND 230 GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy ) AS foo WHERE CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev / mean END > 1 ) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM inv AS inv1 JOIN inv AS inv2 ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.d_moy = 1 AND inv2.d_moy = 2 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov;

WITH inv AS (SELECT w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy ,stdev,mean, CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev/mean END cov FROM (SELECT w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy ,stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) stdev,avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) mean FROM inventory, item, warehouse, date_dim WHERE inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001 AND i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Sports') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 30 AND 230 GROUP BY w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy) foo WHERE CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev/mean END > 1) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean, inv1.cov ,inv2.w_warehouse_sk,inv2.i_item_sk,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM (SELECT * FROM inv WHERE d_moy = 1 AND cov > 1.5) AS inv1 JOIN (SELECT * FROM inv WHERE d_moy = 2) AS inv2 ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean,inv1.cov ,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov;

SELECT MIN(w_state), MIN(i_item_id), MIN(cs_item_sk), MIN(cs_order_number), MIN(cr_item_sk), MIN(cr_order_number) FROM catalog_sales INNER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cr_reason_sk = 40) INNER JOIN item ON (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND i_category = 'Sports' AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 61 AND 100) INNER JOIN warehouse ON (cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk) INNER JOIN date_dim ON (cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN (CAST('2001-04-07' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND (CAST('2001-04-07' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY)) WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 14 AND 33;

SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM ( SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_moy = 4 ) AS d2 JOIN store_returns ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk JOIN store_sales ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_date BETWEEN (d2.d_date - INTERVAL '120' DAY) AND d2.d_date JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip LIMIT 100;

SELECT min(s_store_name), min(s_company_id), min(s_street_number), min(s_street_name), min(s_suite_number), min(s_city), min(s_zip), min(ss_ticket_number), min(ss_sold_date_sk), min(sr_returned_date_sk), min(ss_item_sk), min(d1.d_date_sk) FROM (SELECT * FROM store_sales) AS ss JOIN (SELECT * FROM store_returns) AS sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk AND ss.ss_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk JOIN (SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_suite_number, s_city, s_zip, s_state FROM store WHERE s_state IN ('MI','NC','WI')) AS s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_dow = 4) AS d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 2) AS d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d1.d_date BETWEEN (d2.d_date - INTERVAL '120' DAY) AND d2.d_date;

WITH cs_or_ws_sales_filtered AS ( SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs_item_sk AS item_sk, cs_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws_item_sk AS item_sk, ws_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost FROM web_sales ), filtered_item AS ( SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Sports' AND i_class = 'camping' ), filtered_date_dim_cust AS ( SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 6 AND d_year = 2001 ), filtered_customer AS ( SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM customer WHERE c_birth_year BETWEEN 1932 AND 1945 ), my_customers AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_current_addr_sk FROM cs_or_ws_sales_filtered cs_or_ws_sales JOIN filtered_item i ON cs_or_ws_sales.item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN filtered_date_dim_cust d ON cs_or_ws_sales.sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN filtered_customer c ON cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE cs_or_ws_sales.wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48 ), month_seq_const AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 1 AS lower_bound, d_month_seq + 3 AS upper_bound FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 6 ), my_revenue AS ( SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue FROM my_customers mc JOIN store_sales ss ON mc.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON mc.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN store s ON ca.ca_county = s.s_county AND ca.ca_state = s.s_state JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk CROSS JOIN month_seq_const msc WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48 AND s.s_state IN ('IA','MD','MO','MS','NE','NY','OK','TN','TX','VA') AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN msc.lower_bound AND msc.upper_bound GROUP BY c_customer_sk ), segments AS ( SELECT CAST((revenue/50) AS INT) AS segment FROM my_revenue ) SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS num_customers, segment * 50 AS segment_base FROM segments GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment, num_customers LIMIT 100;

WITH wss AS ( SELECT d_week_seq, ss_store_sk, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Sunday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sun_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Monday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS mon_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Tuesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS tue_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Wednesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS wed_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Thursday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS thu_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Friday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS fri_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name='Saturday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sat_sales FROM store_sales INNER JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 17 * 0.01 AND 37 * 0.01 WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1207 AND 1207 + 23 GROUP BY d_week_seq, ss_store_sk ) SELECT s_store_name1, s_store_id1, d_week_seq1, sun_sales1 / sun_sales2, mon_sales1 / mon_sales2, tue_sales1 / tue_sales2, wed_sales1 / wed_sales2, thu_sales1 / thu_sales2, fri_sales1 / fri_sales2, sat_sales1 / sat_sales2 FROM ( SELECT s_store_name AS s_store_name1, wss.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq1, s_store_id AS s_store_id1, sun_sales AS sun_sales1, mon_sales AS mon_sales1, tue_sales AS tue_sales1, wed_sales AS wed_sales1, thu_sales AS thu_sales1, fri_sales AS fri_sales1, sat_sales AS sat_sales1 FROM wss, store, date_dim d WHERE d.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1207 AND 1207 + 11 AND s_state IN ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NM','OH','OR','TX') ) y, ( SELECT s_store_name AS s_store_name2, wss.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq2, s_store_id AS s_store_id2, sun_sales AS sun_sales2, mon_sales AS mon_sales2, tue_sales AS tue_sales2, wed_sales AS wed_sales2, thu_sales AS thu_sales2, fri_sales AS fri_sales2, sat_sales AS sat_sales2 FROM wss, store, date_dim d WHERE d.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1207 + 12 AND 1207 + 23 AND s_state IN ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NM','OH','OR','TX') ) x WHERE s_store_id1 = s_store_id2 AND d_week_seq1 = d_week_seq2 - 52 ORDER BY s_store_name1, s_store_id1, d_week_seq1 LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_d1 AS (SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001), filtered_d2 AS (SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq FROM date_dim), filtered_d3 AS (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim), filtered_item AS (SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_desc, i_category FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')), filtered_cd AS (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 4 AND 6), filtered_hd AS (SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_buy_potential = '>10000') SELECT i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq, SUM(CASE WHEN p_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_promo, SUM(CASE WHEN p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt FROM catalog_sales JOIN inventory ON (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk AND inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity) JOIN warehouse ON (w_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk) JOIN filtered_item item ON (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) JOIN filtered_cd cd ON (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) JOIN filtered_hd hd ON (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) JOIN filtered_d1 d1 ON (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) JOIN filtered_d2 d2 ON (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) JOIN filtered_d3 d3 ON (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day') LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion ON (cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk) LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND cr_order_number = cs_order_number) WHERE d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37 GROUP BY i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq ORDER BY total_cnt DESC, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq LIMIT 100;

SELECT MIN(i_item_sk), MIN(w_warehouse_name), MIN(d1.d_week_seq), MIN(cs_item_sk), MIN(cs_order_number), MIN(inv_item_sk) FROM (SELECT * FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100) AS catalog_sales INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM inventory) AS inventory ON (catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = inventory.inv_item_sk) INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM warehouse) AS warehouse ON (warehouse.w_warehouse_sk = inventory.inv_warehouse_sk) INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')) AS item ON (item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk) INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 5 AND 7) AS customer_demographics ON (catalog_sales.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk) INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000') AS household_demographics ON (catalog_sales.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk) INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d1 ON (catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d2 ON (inventory.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim) AS d3 ON (catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion ON (catalog_sales.cs_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk) LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (catalog_returns.cr_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk AND catalog_returns.cr_order_number = catalog_sales.cs_order_number) WHERE d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq AND inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand < catalog_sales.cs_quantity AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day' AND catalog_sales.cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND inventory.inv_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND warehouse.w_warehouse_sk IS NOT NULL AND inventory.inv_warehouse_sk IS NOT NULL AND item.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND catalog_sales.cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND catalog_sales.cs_bill_cdemo_sk IS NOT NULL AND customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk IS with ssr as ( select s_store_id as store_id, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) as sales, sum(coalesce(sr_return_amt, 0)) as returns, sum(ss_net_profit - coalesce(sr_net_loss, 0)) as profit from date_dim join store_sales on date_dim.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk and date_dim.d_date between cast('2001-08-11' as date) and cast('2001-08-11' as date) + interval '30' day left outer join store_returns on store_sales.ss_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk and store_sales.ss_ticket_number = store_returns.sr_ticket_number join store on store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk join item on store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk and item.i_current_price > 50 and item.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports') join promotion on store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk and promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' and promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N' and promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y' and promotion.p_channel_press = 'N' and promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y' where store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60 group by s_store_id ), csr as ( select cp_catalog_page_id as catalog_page_id, sum(cs_ext_sales_price) as sales, sum(coalesce(cr_return_amount, 0)) as returns, sum(cs_net_profit - coalesce(cr_net_loss, 0)) as profit from date_dim join catalog_sales on date_dim.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk and date_dim.d_date between cast('2001-08-11' as date) and cast('2001-08-11' as date) + interval '30' day left outer join catalog_returns on catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = catalog_returns.cr_item_sk and catalog_sales.cs_order_number = catalog_returns.cr_order_number join catalog_page on catalog_sales.cs_catalog_page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk join item on catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk and item.i_current_price > 50 and item.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports') join promotion on catalog_sales.cs_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk and promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' and promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N' and promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y' and promotion.p_channel_press = 'N' and promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y' where catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60 group by cp_catalog_page_id ), wsr as ( select web_site_id, sum(ws_ext_sales_price) as sales, sum(coalesce(wr_return_amt, 0)) as returns, sum(ws_net_profit - coalesce(wr_net_loss, 0)) as profit from date_dim join web_sales on date_dim.d_date_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk and date_dim.d_date between cast('2001-08-11' as date) and cast('2001-08-11' as date) + interval '30' day left outer join web_returns on web_sales.ws_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk and web_sales.ws_order_number = web_returns.wr_order_number join web_site on web_sales.ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk join item on web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk and item.i_current_price > 50 and item.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports') join promotion on web_sales.ws_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk and promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' and promotion.p_channel_tv = 'N' and promotion.p_channel_radio = 'Y' and promotion.p_channel_press = 'N' and promotion.p_channel_event = 'Y' where web_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60 group by web_site_id ) select channel, id, sum(sales) as sales, sum(returns) as returns, sum(profit) as profit from ( select 'store channel' as channel, 'store' || store_id as id, sales, returns, profit from ssr union all select 'catalog channel' as channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id as id, sales, returns, profit from csr union all select 'web channel' as channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id as id, sales, returns, profit from wsr ) x group by rollup (channel, id) order by channel, id limit 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS ( SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return FROM catalog_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state ), state_avg_return AS ( SELECT ctr_state, AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_val FROM customer_total_return WHERE ctr_state = 'OR' GROUP BY ctr_state ) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr1.ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return ctr1, customer_address, customer, state_avg_return sar WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sar.avg_val AND ctr1.ctr_state = sar.ctr_state AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'OR' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100;

SELECT substring(r_reason_desc, 1, 20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee) FROM web_sales JOIN web_returns ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number JOIN web_page ON ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status FROM customer_demographics) cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr_refunded_cdemo_sk JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status FROM customer_demographics) cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr_returning_cdemo_sk JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = wr_refunded_addr_sk JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 JOIN reason ON r_reason_sk = wr_reason_sk WHERE ( ( cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND cd2.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 ) OR ( cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 ) OR ( cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 ) ) AND ( ( ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'IN', 'VA') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200 ) OR ( ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('MT', 'NM', 'OR') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300 ) OR ( ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'OH') AND ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250 ) ) GROUP BY r_reason_desc ORDER BY substring(r_reason_desc, 1, 20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee) LIMIT 100;

SELECT SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee) FROM web_sales ws INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 1999 INNER JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk INNER JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk INNER JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk WHERE ( ( cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 ) OR ( cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = '4 yr Degree' AND cd2.cd_education_status = '4 yr Degree' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 ) OR ( cd1.cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd2.cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND cd2.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 ) ) AND ( ( ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('NE', 'TN', 'TX') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200 ) OR ( ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('MS', 'NY', 'VA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300 ) OR ( ca.ca_country = 'United States' AND ca.ca_state IN ('MS', 'TN', 'TX') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250 ) ) GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc ORDER BY SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20), AVG(ws.ws_quantity), AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash), AVG(wr.wr_fee) LIMIT 100;

WITH store_sales_filtered AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203 JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947 WHERE ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300 AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27 ), catalog_sales_filtered AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203 JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947 WHERE cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300 AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27 ), web_sales_filtered AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203 JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1941 AND 1947 WHERE ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300 AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 27 ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales_filtered ssf WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog_sales_filtered csf WHERE csf.c_last_name = ssf.c_last_name AND csf.c_first_name = ssf.c_first_name AND csf.d_date = ssf.d_date ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM web_sales_filtered wsf WHERE wsf.c_last_name = ssf.c_last_name AND wsf.c_first_name = ssf.c_first_name AND wsf.d_date = ssf.d_date );

SELECT cc_call_center_id AS Call_Center, cc_name AS Call_Center_Name, cc_manager AS Manager, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS Returns_Loss FROM call_center JOIN catalog_returns ON cr_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 10) d ON cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN (SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_hdemo_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM customer JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'Unknown') OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')) cd ON cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk JOIN (SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_buy_potential LIKE 'Unknown%') hd ON hd_demo_sk = c_current_hdemo_sk JOIN (SELECT ca_address_sk FROM customer_address WHERE ca_gmt_offset = -7) ca ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk) c ON cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY cc_call_center_id, cc_name, cc_manager ORDER BY SUM(cr_net_loss) DESC;

SELECT min(cc_call_center_id), min(cc_name), min(cc_manager), min(cr_net_loss), min(cr_item_sk), min(cr_order_number) FROM call_center JOIN (SELECT cr.* FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 5)) AS filtered_cr ON filtered_cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim ON filtered_cr.cr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk AND date_dim.d_year = 1999 AND date_dim.d_moy = 5 JOIN customer ON filtered_cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics ON customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk = customer.c_current_cdemo_sk AND ((customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'M' AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Unknown') OR (customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')) JOIN household_demographics ON household_demographics.hd_demo_sk = customer.c_current_hdemo_sk AND household_demographics.hd_buy_potential LIKE '0-500%' JOIN customer_address ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = customer.c_current_addr_sk AND customer_address.ca_gmt_offset = -7;

SELECT sum(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount" FROM (SELECT * FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88) AS ws JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 394 AND 593 OR i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports'))) AS i ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-11' AND CAST('2002-02-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY) AS d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk JOIN ( SELECT ws_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM web_sales JOIN date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk WHERE date_dim.d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-11' AND CAST('2002-02-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND web_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88 AND web_sales.ws_sales_price / web_sales.ws_list_price BETWEEN 85 * 0.01 AND 100 * 0.01 GROUP BY ws_item_sk ) AS sub ON sub.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND sub.ws_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk WHERE ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > sub.avg_discount AND i.i_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND d.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND sub.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sum(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

WITH avg_discount AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_ext_discount_amt FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk WHERE dd.d_date BETWEEN '2001-01-31' AND CAST('2001-01-31' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77 AND ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.17 AND 0.32 GROUP BY ws_item_sk ) SELECT SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount" FROM item i JOIN web_sales ws ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77 JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_date BETWEEN '2001-01-31' AND CAST('2001-01-31' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY LEFT JOIN avg_discount ad ON ws.ws_item_sk = ad.ws_item_sk WHERE (i.i_manufact_id BETWEEN 749 AND 948 OR i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')) AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > ad.avg_ext_discount_amt ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;

WITH avg_discount AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_amount FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN '1999-03-22' AND '1999-06-20' AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.69 AND 0.84 GROUP BY ws_item_sk ) SELECT SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount" FROM (SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_ext_discount_amt FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100) AS ws JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 423 AND 622 OR i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women'))) AS i ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-03-22' AND '1999-06-20') AS d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk JOIN avg_discount AS ad ON ad.ws_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk WHERE ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > ad.avg_amount GROUP BY () ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;
